_comment: Reverse-chronological research news. Every entry corresponds to a real event recorded in the CV (publications, conference venues, review milestones). Add new items at the top. 'tag' categorises the update.

news.title: Paper accepted at Indian Control Conference 2026
news.body: Our work on dual-arm cooperative manipulation through shared vision has been accepted at the Indian Control Conference (ICC) 2026.

news.title: Preprint on prior-guided policy learning under review at Array
news.body: Prior-guided policy learning for cooperative dual-arm pre-assembly alignment is under review at Array (Elsevier); the preprint is available on SSRN (doi:10.2139/ssrn.7305686).

news.title: Paper under review at Results in Engineering
news.body: Our work on continuous trajectory tracking for non-spherical wrist manipulators via learned differential inverse kinematics has been submitted to Results in Engineering (Elsevier) and is under review.

news.title: Journal submission under review at Journal of Intelligent & Robotic Systems
news.body: Competitive task allocation with real-time collision avoidance for autonomous dual-arm manipulation has been submitted to the Journal of Intelligent & Robotic Systems (Springer) and is under review.

news.title: iAPF published in Frontiers in Robotics and AI
news.body: Our improved Artificial Potential Field framework for asymmetric dual-arm manipulation with real-time inter-arm collision avoidance appeared in Frontiers in Robotics and AI (doi:10.3389/frobt.2025.1604506).

news.title: Presented at ICCAS 2025, Incheon
news.body: Presented kinematics-based real-time distance monitoring for safe multi-arm robot operations at the 25th International Conference on Control, Automation and Systems in Incheon, Republic of Korea.

news.title: Presented at IEEE CASE 2024, Bari
news.body: Presented automated vision-based bolt sorting by a manipulator for industrial applications at the IEEE 20th International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering in Bari, Italy.

news.title: Presented at ICCMA 2024, London
news.body: Presented automated vision-based bolt handling for industrial applications at the 12th International Conference on Control, Mechatronics and Automation in London, United Kingdom.
